_comment: Source registry for glpi_search_knowledge_unified. Copy to sources.json. Each source exposes the kb_search contract (see CONTRACT.md) via a table or view named in `relation`; secrets (DSNs) live in .env, referenced by dsn_env. `weight` boosts a source in cross-source RRF (e.g. official docs > forum). `dedup` collapses repost-prone titles within the source.
